name: Kimpton Cottonwood Hotel
positioning: Revival of the historic 1916 Blackstone Hotel in Omaha's Blackstone District, with a steakhouse, a speakeasy-style cocktail bar and a seasonal pool
best_for: Travelers who want a historic-building hotel in the Blackstone District

facts.text: The hotel is a revival of the historic Blackstone Hotel, which dates to 1916.
The hotel is set in the revitalized Blackstone District, a short drive from downtown Omaha.
The hotel has a steakhouse, The Committee Chophouse, with an interactive dessert menu.
The Cottonwood Room is a cocktail bar on the lower level of the hotel with a speakeasy feel.
Orleans Room serves a menu built on seasonally changing, locally sourced ingredients.
Petit Orleans serves cappuccino and pastries.
The hotel displays a locally curated art collection in its common areas.
The outdoor pool deck has loungers, rentable cabanas and a hot tub.
The hotel offers bike cruisers for guests to explore nearby museums and parks.
The hotel welcomes pets of any size, weight or breed at no extra charge.

highlights.text: The hotel is a revival of the historic Blackstone Hotel, which dates to 1916.
The Committee Chophouse is a steakhouse with an interactive dessert menu.
The Cottonwood Room is a lower-level cocktail bar with a speakeasy feel.
A locally curated art collection is displayed in the common areas.

considerations.text: The Cottonwood Pool Club is open seasonally, from early May to mid-September.
Valet parking is offered to overnight guests, and the parking facility is off-site.
The hotel has no local area shuttle.
